headline: Approved extending Abbott Court development closing to February 1, 2027; reauthorized commercial tax exemption program; approved $50,790.30 fire budget transfer.
summary: Residents spoke during public forum about House Bill 1331 and the school budget, and the council took no vote on the bill. The council reauthorized the commercial and industrial property tax exemption program and extended the Abbott Court closing date to February 1, 2027. It also approved budget transfers for finance, fire, and emergency management, and a $7,300 withdrawal from the Taylor Library capital reserve.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the August 4, 2026 minutes, Ordinance #2026-003, and Resolution #2026-050, 6-0-0.
Approved appointing Colin Ratey as an alternate member of the Net Zero Task Force, term to March 31, 2029, 6-0-0.
Adopted Ordinance #2026-002, reauthorizing the Derry Commercial/Industrial Property Tax Exemption Program, 6-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-044, accepting $86,487 in unanticipated revenues to cover finance department expenses, 6-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-045, a $50,790.30 supplemental appropriation for the FY26 fire budget, 6-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-046, a $10,120.48 supplemental appropriation for the FY26 emergency management budget, 6-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-048, withdrawing $7,300 from the Taylor Library capital reserve fund for soffit and chimney repairs, 6-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-047, accepting easements on Humphrey Road, 6-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-049, extending the closing date under the Abbott Court Master Development Agreement to February 1, 2027, 6-0-0.
